items.title: Omnicom Group (OMC) Names Andrew Robertson CEO As Troy Ruhanen Retires
items.summary: Omnicom Group (NYSE:OMC) announced a leadership change at Omnicom Advertising, with CEO Troy Ruhanen retiring from his role. Andrew Robertson has been appointed as Ruhanen's successor, taking over leadership of the Omnicom Advertising division. The transition marks a shift in oversight for a key Omnicom business unit that manages major global client relationships. items.title: Omnicom Group Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Omnicom Group Inc (NYSE:OMC) recently announced a total dividend of $0.80 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for Sept. 18, 2026.  This payout consists of a $0.80 per share cash dividend payable on Oct. 9, 2026.  For income-focused investors, the ex-dividend date is a critical marker: shareholders must own the stock before this date to qualify for the payment.
